one_sentence: This document organizes one-page stories into thematic lanes for reader-friendly navigation and GPT-driven editing.
executive_summary: This README file defines the organizational structure for a collection of one-page stories, grouping them into thematic lanes such as starting-point, truth-and-pushback, measure-and-judgment, repair-and-order, breakdown-and-coherence, and one-offs. The structure is designed to facilitate easier HTML and GPT-driven editing, with a note that the original landing page remains in index.html. The conclusion is that this lane system provides a clear, navigable framework for managing and expanding the story collection.
